model_and_devices.selected_model: NMOS_IDEAL Level 1, VTO=0.7 V, KP=0.0002 A/V^2, LAMBDA=0.02 1/V
model_and_devices.M1_positive: W=10 um L=1 um m=1, VIN1/VCLK1/VOUT1/VSS
model_and_devices.M2_negative: W=10 um L=1 um m=1, VIN2/VCLK1/VOUT2/VSS

evaluation_policy.functional_gate: existing V1 differential Track response and Hold isolation

conditions.vin_diff_basis: conditional engineering test; 0.6 V total differential span gives 0.15 V programmed Track/Hold steps; no historical differential sweep
conditions.common_mode_basis: conditional use of ideal_param.yaml VIN1=VIN2=1.2 V nominal, not an approved VCM operating range
conditions.terminal_limit_basis: operating_space.yaml VSS..VDD compatibility with nominal 3.3 V and ideal model; conditional fixture limit, not a certified device rating
conditions.vin_edge_basis: conditional finite edge chosen for unambiguous 1 us V1 event windows
conditions.clock_basis: 1 MHz/3.3 V from ideal_param.yaml and archived summary; 50% duty, 5 ns edges and zero phase delay are conditional engineering selections because no per-edge PULSE exists
conditions.temperature_basis: conditional engineering room-temperature test; no frozen source temperature
conditions.startup_basis: V1 protocol; archived summary says no startup perturbation required, not proof two cycles are sufficient

condition_provenance.vin_range_v: conditional differential -0.3..0.3 V engineering test span
condition_provenance.fixed_common_mode_v: conditional 1.2 V from two archived nominal DC inputs
condition_provenance.clock_edges_s: conditional 5 ns rise/fall engineering test edges

waveforms.VIN1: VCM + VIN_DIFF/2, finite 5 ns PWL around proposed levels
waveforms.VIN2: VCM - VIN_DIFF/2, finite 5 ns PWL around proposed levels
waveforms.VCLK1: one periodic 0/3.3 V PULSE; rise 5 ns, high plateau 495 ns, fall 5 ns, period 1 us, first rise at t=0

measurement.event_origin: relative to each measured cycle's Track start; V1 build_fixture formula, subject to offline recomputation

source_supported: two NMOS paths share one VCLK1
unresolved_required_before_real_run: operator acceptance of conditional differential/clock/test limits
native worker support for two PWL input sources

readiness: fixture values specified for operator review; NOT approved for real execution
